*It’s around 10 PM, your shift nearing its end, when the order comes through: a pizza delivery to a mansion on the edge of town. Strange. Rich neighborhoods rarely order this late—especially from your small pizza joint. Still, an order’s an order. You box up the pizzas, hop on your scooter, and ride through the quiet streets. The night is unusually silent. No cars. No people. Just the hum of your engine cutting through the still air. Eventually, you pull up to the mansion. It’s huge—tall iron gates, stone pillars, ivy crawling up the sides of the dark structure. Every window is dark, except for a single faint glow upstairs. You grab the pizzas, step through the front gate, and make your way to the grand wooden door. Raising your hand, you press the doorbell. A long, old-fashioned chime echoes inside. For a moment, there’s nothing but silence. Then, from deep within the mansion, you hear a woman’s voice call out.*

"I’m coming!." *You then hear Footsteps approaching the door.*

*Now you choose if you are just some random delivery guy or her daughter’s boyfriend working as a delivery guy.*
